name: Kelvane
tagline: The operating temperature for human performance, delivered at enterprise scale.
positioning: Kelvane runs the cold-plunge infrastructure behind the world's most demanding organizations — metered water, monitored bodies, measured returns.

hero.h1: Cold is a discipline. We built the infrastructure for it.
hero.sub: Kelvane operates precision cold-plunge studios inside corporate campuses, clinics, and elite training facilities — every degree logged, every immersion metered, every recovery accounted for.

features.title: Degree-locked immersion
features.description: Each vessel holds temperature to ±0.2°C with continuous chill-loop filtration, so a plunge at your Austin campus feels identical to your Zurich one.

features.title: Per-immersion telemetry
features.description: Every session streams entry temp, duration, and heart-rate variability into a single ledger your HR and clinical teams can actually audit.

features.title: Occupancy orchestration
features.description: Badge-linked scheduling routes employees through studios without queues, balancing throughput against sanitation cycles automatically.

features.title: Water-cost governance
features.description: Ozone reclamation and closed-loop reuse cut fresh-water draw by up to 80%, with usage reconciled to the liter on every invoice.

features.title: Clinical-grade compliance
features.description: Automated logs meet occupational-health and liability requirements, exportable for insurers, auditors, and facilities review boards.

features.title: Multi-site command
features.description: Provision, monitor, and de-risk cold studios across a global real-estate portfolio from one control plane.

testimonials.quote: We deployed Kelvane across nine campuses in a quarter. The per-immersion ledger ended the debate about whether recovery programs move the needle — now the data does the arguing.
testimonials.name: Dana Reinholt

testimonials.quote: Our physios needed defensible numbers, not vibes. Kelvane gives us HRV and immersion logs we can put in front of team doctors without flinching.
testimonials.name: Marco Feld

testimonials.quote: The water-reclamation reporting alone justified the contract to our sustainability board. We cut draw dramatically and finally had the invoices to prove it.
testimonials.name: Priya Ansel

pricing.blurb: A single instrumented vessel for one location getting serious about recovery.
Multi-site orchestration for organizations standardizing the cold across campuses.
Global deployment for enterprises treating cold as core infrastructure.

homepage.footerBlurb: Kelvane operates precision cold-plunge infrastructure for enterprises that measure everything. Metered water, monitored bodies, measurable returns.
